title: Container Bookings: amount of a late VGM entry
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, the full fee for a late verified gross mass is the tier's per-container late VGM fee multiplied by the chargeable containers. A VGM that was not late books nothing; a late VGM within the free allowance on the booking is recorded at 0.00; a late VGM outside it is recorded at the full fee. The product is rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

## Decision table
| Received late | Within the free allowance | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| no | not relevant | nothing is booked |
| yes | yes | 0.00 |
| yes | no | per-container late VGM fee multiplied by the chargeable containers, rounded at the end |

## Worked example (hypothetical)
*Hypothetical per-container fee of 95.00 and 8 chargeable containers, for illustration only:* 95.00 multiplied by 8 is 760.00, recorded as one late VGM entry.
